# ManageMyWeb (https://www.managemyweb.co)

> ManageMyWeb turns standard e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom online stores) into interactive 3D virtual storefronts that customers can walk inside on any mobile phone or desktop browser—and provides 24/7 managed web operations, cloud hosting, speed optimization, and conversion engineering.

## Core Services & Value Proposition
- **Custom 3D E-Commerce Storefronts**: Walkable 60fps WebGL / Three.js 3D virtual retail showrooms where shoppers navigate virtual aisles, inspect products in 360° on 3D shelves, select variants, and complete checkout in one tap via Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Stripe.
- **Native E-Commerce Sync**: Connects directly to existing Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom catalogs with real-time inventory, pricing, variant, and cart synchronization.
- **Full-Stack Managed Web Operations**: 24/7 cloud hosting, domain & DNS management, SSL, business email (DMARC/SPF/DKIM), Core Web Vitals speed optimization (< 1.1s load time), security backups, and same-day store updates via WhatsApp.
- **2-Step Engagement Model (No Fixed Upfront Blind Pricing)**:
  - **Option 1 (Demo First)**: Step 1: Complimentary 48-hour 3D store demo built with the client's real products at zero cost → Step 2: Custom itemized quotation tailored to catalog size.
  - **Option 2 (Direct Quotation)**: Request an itemized custom quotation directly for a 3D storefront build, managed web operations, or both.
